question_text: My parents didn't save enough money to buy a new house in Aqaba.  The sentence which has a similar meaning to the one above is…

choices.A: if only they have saved enough money to buy a new house in Aqaba.
choices.B: if only they hadn't saved enough money to buy a new house in Aqaba.
choices.C: if only they had saved enough money to buy a new house in Aqaba.
choices.D: if only they haven't saved enough money to buy a new house in Aqaba.
